notes: The game's sound effects as prompts (owner decisions 2026-11-14). Every sound is generated with ElevenLabs' newest sound-effect model, model_id below, which tools/generate-sfx always sends because the API still defaults to v2. This public repo holds this sheet and the tool, never the audio: ElevenLabs' terms forbid making output available as isolated audio files. .gitignore keeps audio out of Git and tools/check_sfx.mjs fails if any is tracked. tools/sfx/README.md explains the workflow and the hard cases.

Style: realistic. The player is a real wooden treasure chest full of gold coins, with iron straps, brass fittings and big leather-soled shoes, flying on a small twin-nozzle rocket backpack, not a cartoon. Cars and the world are realistic too. No music, and no sounds for things the game does not model (no horn, gulls, foghorn or traffic); spraying was removed from the game.

Prompts follow ElevenLabs' guidance (checked 2026-11-14). Each prompt is one sound, described as an action, setting and performance in a short sentence of at most 450 characters, with recording-quality words. A prompt never asks for a number of repetitions (one footstep per generation), and a sequence is split into several prompts. The length, looping and prompt influence are set per row, not described in the text. Prompts use US English (tire, curb, gasoline), as sound libraries word them.

Credits: credits_per_second for each second of the set duration, for every candidate generated (keep_takes x candidates_per_take). The dry run of tools/generate-sfx prints them per row, per tier and in total.

prompt_influence: 0.5 to 0.6 where takes must match each other or follow a narrow brief (the three engine loops, single footsteps, interface clicks); 0.35 to 0.45 where natural variety helps (impacts, ambience). The API default is 0.3.

Event ids (P player, V vehicle, B ball, A ambient, U interface) follow the 2026-11-14 code inventory of f72d6b21. The hook named with each is where its sound would be played. Each event is voiced by at least one row or listed under not_voiced with the reason.

car.name: 2014 Toyota RAV4
car.why: One sound set for every car to start (owner 2026-11-14), named in every prompt that mentions a car so the set stays consistent. The crossover is the island's most common parked body (158 of the 458 parked_car rows in generated/world/street_detail.json at f72d6b21). A 2014 RAV4 is an ordinary, very common crossover; the engine prompts name its standard 2.5-liter four-cylinder gasoline engine (the hybrid came later), so the engine stays audible at low speed.

oneshot_step.what: A short transient (footstep, kick). Cut the silence before it, keep at most max_seconds and fade out the end.

oneshot_short.what: A small ringing one-shot (coins). As oneshot_step, with room for the ring.

oneshot.what: A positional one-shot (impact, door, splash). Cut the silence at both ends and fade out the tail.

oneshot_lead_in.what: A one-shot that hands over to a loop (jet start, engine start). Cut the silence before it, keep its end and fade it out under the loop's fade-in.

ui.what: An interface click. As oneshot_step, shorter and quieter.

loop_mono.what: A positional loop (engine, jet, tires, scrapes). Drop codec padding (digital silence) at both ends, then crossfade the end into the start so the seam is continuous whatever the generator delivered.

loop_bed_mono.what: A long positional ambience loop (foliage near trees). As loop_mono with a long crossfade that hides a change of texture at the seam.

loop_bed_stereo.what: A long non-positional ambience bed (wind, bay water). As loop_bed_mono, kept in stereo.

not_voiced.A9: Nothing there moves in the game; a bridge or city hum would be a sound for something the game does not model (owner 2026-11-14).
not_voiced.V27: Nothing detects a car in a shrub (no hook); left for a pass that adds one.
not_voiced.U7: A ready sting would be music (none, owner 2026-11-14); the wind and water beds fading in at play mark it instead.
not_voiced.U8: A failed load needs no sound.

sounds.prompt: High-quality, professionally recorded footstep foley: a single step of a big, hard leather-soled shoe landing firmly on dry asphalt, a crisp heel-and-sole impact, close-miked, dry outdoor recording.
sounds.notes: Roads, paths, kerbs and roofs. One footstep per generation; eight takes so 10 steps a second do not repeat audibly. Gain and pitch follow speed (run versus walk, P15).

sounds.prompt: High-quality, professionally recorded footstep foley: a single step of a big, hard leather-soled shoe landing on short dry grass over firm soil, a soft muffled thud with a light grass crunch, close-miked outdoors.
sounds.notes: Bare land and grass areas: the two surface sets the ground data already tells apart.

sounds.prompt: High-quality, professionally recorded foley one-shot: a heap of gold coins inside a closed wooden treasure chest given a short sharp jolt, a quick bright jingle of coins muffled by the wood, close-miked.
sounds.notes: Layered on running footsteps above 6 m/s, at the coin hop's strength.

sounds.prompt: High-quality, professionally recorded foley impact: a heavy iron-strapped wooden chest full of gold coins dropped upright onto pavement from knee height, a solid wooden thump with the coins clinking inside, close-miked.
sounds.notes: Volume follows the landing's impact; the fast drop has its own heavier slam.

sounds.prompt: High-quality recording of a small twin-nozzle rocket backpack igniting at full power outdoors: a sudden sharp whoosh of hot gas swelling at once into a loud, steady roaring hiss, close-miked.
sounds.notes: Plays over the jet loop's fade-in; a lift-off (P5) is a jet start. Stepping off an edge makes no sound of its own.

sounds.prompt: High-quality recording of a small twin-nozzle rocket backpack firing steadily at full power outdoors: a constant loud roaring hiss of hot exhaust with a low rumble underneath, even and unchanging, close-miked.
sounds.notes: The sustain. Its gain follows the flame (0.04 s up, 0.07 s down) so taps of any length work.

sounds.prompt: High-quality recording of a small twin-nozzle rocket backpack shutting off outdoors: a loud roaring hiss of hot exhaust cut off abruptly, ending in a brief sputter and a fading puff of gas, close-miked.
sounds.notes: The release tail, played as the loop fades out.

sounds.prompt: High-quality, professionally recorded foley: a closed wooden treasure chest shaking hard and fast, its heavy lid chattering against the rim and the gold coins inside jingling constantly, close-miked.
sounds.notes: The 12 Hz lid rattle is too fast for one-shots; a layer under the jet loop, gain by the lid's speed. Kept apart from the jet: one sound per prompt.

sounds.prompt: High-quality, professionally recorded foley one-shot: the driver's door of a 2014 Toyota RAV4 being opened, a firm click of the door latch releasing and the door swinging open, recorded close outdoors.
sounds.notes: Getting in and getting out are sequences of door, engine and door, so each part is its own prompt.

sounds.prompt: High-quality, professionally recorded foley one-shot: the driver's door of a 2014 Toyota RAV4 being shut firmly, a solid thunk of the door closing with the latch catching, recorded close outdoors.

High-quality recording of a 2014 Toyota RAV4 with a 2.5-liter four-cylinder gasoline engine starting: the starter motor cranks briefly, the engine catches with a light rev and settles into a smooth idle, recorded outside near the exhaust.
sounds.notes: Ends on idle and fades out under the idle loop.

sounds.prompt: High-quality recording of a 2014 Toyota RAV4 with a 2.5-liter four-cylinder gasoline engine idling and then switched off: the engine shudders briefly and stops, leaving quiet, recorded outside near the exhaust.
sounds.notes: Starts at idle, so it takes over from the idle loop as that fades out.

sounds.prompt: High-quality recording of a 2014 Toyota RAV4 with a 2.5-liter four-cylinder gasoline engine idling steadily while parked, a smooth low engine hum with a soft exhaust burble, recorded outside behind the vehicle near the exhaust.
sounds.notes: Engine, one of three: idle, low and high are steady-state loops of the same car from the same place behind it, crossfaded by a virtual rev from throttle and speed over top speed, each pitched within about a third of an octave. Three candidates each, to pick a trio that matches.

sounds.prompt: High-quality recording of a 2014 Toyota RAV4 with a 2.5-liter four-cylinder gasoline engine cruising at a steady low speed on asphalt, an even, relaxed engine drone with light tire noise, recorded from outside following behind the vehicle.
sounds.notes: Engine, two of three; carries the asphalt road noise (V4), so tarmac needs no separate rolling loop.

sounds.prompt: High-quality recording of a 2014 Toyota RAV4 with a 2.5-liter four-cylinder gasoline engine held at high revs under full throttle on asphalt, a steady strained engine roar with tire noise, recorded from outside following behind the vehicle.
sounds.notes: Engine, three of three. Reverse and coasting reuse the same loops at lower gain.

sounds.prompt: High-quality recording of the tires of a 2014 Toyota RAV4 skidding sideways across dry asphalt, a continuous loud rubber squeal with gritty scrubbing, recorded close outdoors.
sounds.notes: One loop that always runs while driving, gain from the smoothed slip and handbrake (about 50 ms up, 150 ms down) and slight pitch from speed, so a flickering drift never restarts a sound. Hard braking slides through the same loop.

sounds.prompt: High-quality recording of a 2014 Toyota RAV4 bumping into another parked vehicle at low speed, a dull plastic bumper thud with a light metallic knock and rattle, recorded close outdoors.
sounds.notes: Shoves, wakes and light crashes; volume from the speed change. Needs a voice cap in a pile-up.

sounds.prompt: High-quality recording of a 2014 Toyota RAV4 crashing hard into a concrete wall at speed, a violent impact of crumpling sheet metal and cracking plastic with debris scattering, recorded close outdoors.
High-quality recording of a 2014 Toyota RAV4 plunging nose first into calm bay water off a rocky shore, a huge heavy splash with water crashing down around it, recorded from the shore.
sounds.notes: Heard from the shore watch camera; volume from the entry speed.

sounds.prompt: High-quality recording of a 2014 Toyota RAV4 smashing through a chain-link fence at speed, the wire mesh rattling and tearing loudly as a steel fence post bends over, recorded outdoors.
sounds.notes: chain_link, chain_link_barbed, chain_link_screened, chain_link_slatted and construction_panel bays; a felled post (V21) plays the same family quieter.

sounds.prompt: High-quality recording of a 2014 Toyota RAV4 crashing through a wooden privacy fence at speed, boards cracking and splintering as a wooden post snaps, recorded outdoors.
sounds.notes: wood_privacy bays and posts.

sounds.prompt: High-quality recording of a 2014 Toyota RAV4 ramming through a steel picket fence at speed, metal bars clanging, bending and scraping in a heavy metallic crash, recorded outdoors.
sounds.notes: steel_picket bays and posts.

sounds.prompt: High-quality recording of a 2014 Toyota RAV4 driving into a tall ball-stop net on metal poles, the nylon netting whipping and tearing as a pole bends over with a dull clang, recorded outdoors.
sounds.notes: ball_stop_net bays and poles.

sounds.prompt: High-quality recording of a 2014 Toyota RAV4 hitting a steel street light pole at speed, a heavy metallic bang and crunch at the base as the pole is knocked loose, recorded outdoors.
sounds.notes: The hit and the fall are two prompts: a sequence is split.

sounds.prompt: High-quality recording of a tall steel street light pole falling onto asphalt, a loud ringing metallic clang on impact with the lamp head cracking and loose parts rattling to rest, recorded outdoors.
sounds.notes: Volume from the lamp's mass (70 to 180 kg) and its speed at the ground contact.

sounds.prompt: High-quality, professionally recorded foley one-shot: a size 5 leather soccer ball nudged with the side of a shoe on a grass field, a soft muted thump, close-miked outdoors.
sounds.notes: Dribbles and a car's nudge; the kick test runs every tick of overlap, so it needs a debounce.

sounds.prompt: High-quality, professionally recorded foley one-shot: a size 5 leather soccer ball struck hard by a shoe on a grass field, a sharp punchy thwack, close-miked outdoors.
sounds.notes: Hard kicks and a car's push, by the speed added.

sounds.prompt: High-quality, professionally recorded foley one-shot: a soccer ball flying into the back of a goal net, a soft swish and ripple of nylon netting with the metal goal frame rattling, recorded outdoors.
sounds.notes: Goals with a net (soccer, GAA); rugby posts have none.

sounds.prompt: High-quality recording of a confetti cannon firing outdoors, a sharp compressed-air pop and a burst of paper confetti fluttering down.
sounds.notes: The burst the game shows (2.6 s of paper confetti); no crowd, since nobody is modelled.

sounds.prompt: Ambience: a steady fresh wind blowing across wide, open, flat ground, a soft broadband rush of air with slow gentle gusts, recorded outdoors with a windshielded stereo microphone.
sounds.notes: The 30 s cap is the bed's length: generated with loop set, then crossfaded over 2 s at the seam. One bed under everything, louder with the player's height. Place names stay out of the prompt so it does not add gulls or traffic.

sounds.prompt: Ambience: small waves from calm bay water lapping and washing against a rock riprap seawall, gentle splashes and trickles between the rocks, close stereo recording at the water's edge.
sounds.notes: As the wind bed; gain from the distance to the shore at a low update rate. Three candidates because a lapping pattern that repeats is easy to hear.

sounds.prompt: High-quality recording of a small, crisp click of a quality plastic switch, a clean short tick, close-miked in a quiet room.
sounds.notes: Menu buttons, the shadow choice and resume.

sounds.prompt: High-quality recording of a soft, low, muted click of a heavy rocker switch, short and clean, close-miked in a quiet room.
sounds.notes: Opening the pause menu.

sounds.prompt: High-quality, professionally recorded foley one-shot: the heavy domed lid of an iron-strapped wooden treasure chest slamming shut, a solid wooden clack with the brass fittings knocking and the gold coins inside rattling, close-miked.
sounds.notes: Volume from the lid's closing speed.

sounds.prompt: High-quality, professionally recorded foley one-shot: a single gold coin flipped out over the wooden rim of a treasure chest, a bright light metallic tink, close-miked.
sounds.notes: Coins thrown out at a run, a jet lift-off (P5) or a hard landing.

sounds.prompt: High-quality, professionally recorded foley one-shot: a single heavy gold coin dropped onto asphalt, a bright metallic ting on impact with a short rattling bounce, close-miked outdoors.
sounds.notes: Up to about 10 contacts a second: rate-limited, never the same take twice running.

sounds.prompt: High-quality recording of strong wind rushing past a heavy object falling fast through open air, a dense steady roar of buffeting airflow, recorded outdoors with a windshielded microphone.
sounds.notes: Gain from the fall speed while C is held.

sounds.prompt: High-quality, professionally recorded foley impact: a heavy iron-strapped wooden chest full of gold coins slamming upright into hard ground from a great height, a deep powerful thud with a gritty crunch and the coins crashing inside, close-miked.
sounds.notes: With the dust poof.

sounds.prompt: High-quality sound design one-shot: a soft, short, smooth airy whoosh, clean and subtle.
sounds.notes: Non-positional: the player or car is moved, so nothing in the world makes this sound.

sounds.prompt: High-quality recording of the brakes of a 2014 Toyota RAV4 squealing as it rolls to a stop on asphalt, a high-pitched disc brake squeal, recorded close outdoors.
sounds.notes: Coming to rest on the brakes; hard braking that slides uses the skid loop.

sounds.prompt: High-quality recording of a 2014 Toyota RAV4 hitting a curb fast so the suspension bottoms out, a deep hollow thump with a rattle of the body, recorded close outdoors.
sounds.notes: Volume from the compression rate at the bump stop.

sounds.prompt: High-quality recording of a 2014 Toyota RAV4 landing hard on its wheels after a jump, a heavy thud and suspension bang with a creak of the body, recorded close outdoors.
sounds.notes: Also the end of a self-righting roll (V14), which drops the car back onto its wheels.

sounds.prompt: High-quality recording of the tires of a 2014 Toyota RAV4 rolling steadily over loose gravel and dirt, a continuous crunching rumble of stones under the tires, recorded close outdoors.
sounds.notes: Off the road (bare land), gain and pitch from speed.

sounds.prompt: High-quality recording of a 2014 Toyota RAV4 rolling slowly down large loose shoreline rocks, a continuous heavy rumble with rocks knocking and grinding under the tires, recorded close outdoors.
sounds.notes: On the shore rocks (the cars' riprap ground).

sounds.prompt: High-quality recording of a 2014 Toyota RAV4 sinking in calm bay water, water gurgling and rushing into the cabin with large bubbles rising and bursting at the surface, recorded from the shore.
sounds.notes: One-shot at the start of sinking, which lasts 1 to 4 s; fade it with the car's depth.

sounds.prompt: High-quality recording of a 2014 Toyota RAV4 hitting a water-filled plastic jersey barrier, a deep hollow plastic thud with water sloshing inside, recorded close outdoors.
sounds.notes: The game's K-rail is a water-filled plastic jersey unit.

sounds.prompt: High-quality recording of a heavy water-filled plastic jersey barrier being shoved along asphalt, a continuous rough scraping drag with water sloshing inside, recorded close outdoors.
sounds.notes: While a shoved barrier slides, gain from its speed.

sounds.prompt: High-quality recording of a 2014 Toyota RAV4 pushing slowly through a small young street tree, leafy branches swishing and scraping along the bodywork as the thin trunk creaks and bends, recorded close outdoors.
sounds.notes: On a new touch of a bending tree.

sounds.prompt: High-quality, professionally recorded foley one-shot: a small young tree springing back upright after being bent over, a quick leafy whoosh and rustle of branches, recorded outdoors.
sounds.notes: Volume from the spring-back's angular speed.

sounds.prompt: High-quality, professionally recorded foley one-shot: a soccer ball bouncing off hard ground, a taut, hollow rubbery thump, close-miked outdoors.
sounds.notes: A new contact on the ground, a wall or a post; volume from the speed change.

sounds.prompt: High-quality recording of a moored aluminum passenger catamaran rocking gently against a steel floating dock, a slow deep creak and groan of the hull and mooring lines, recorded on the dock.
sounds.notes: Timed one-shots at the boat, on the shader's 4 to 5 s roll and pitch, rather than one long loop. The ferry's engine is not modelled (she is docked).

sounds.prompt: High-quality recording of a foam boat fender squeezed between a moored catamaran's hull and a piling as the boat rocks, a low rubbery squeak and groan, recorded close on the dock.
sounds.notes: At the mooring dolphins' foam fenders, timed with the roll.

sounds.prompt: High-quality recording of small waves slapping and gurgling under a steel floating dock beside a moored boat, a hollow wet slap, recorded close on the dock.
sounds.notes: At the ferry float, timed with the heave.

sounds.prompt: High-quality recording of a soft, steady breeze flowing past a light object drifting slowly down through open air, a gentle airy flutter, recorded outdoors with a windshielded microphone.
sounds.notes: The slow descent; the lid's flutter can borrow the rattle loop at low gain.

sounds.prompt: High-quality, professionally recorded foley one-shot: the hinged lid of an old wooden treasure chest lifting a little and settling back, a soft slow creak of wood and brass hinges, close-miked in a quiet space.
sounds.notes: Sparse, while standing. A real chest does not breathe, so there is no breath.

sounds.prompt: High-quality recording of a 2014 Toyota RAV4 sliding upside down on its roof across asphalt, a continuous harsh grinding scrape of sheet metal, recorded close outdoors.
sounds.notes: While the car slides on its roof or side, gain from speed.

sounds.prompt: High-quality, professionally recorded foley one-shot: broken pieces of metal fencing and a bent steel post clattering onto asphalt and settling, recorded close outdoors.
High-quality, professionally recorded foley: a soccer ball rolling steadily across short grass, a soft continuous low rumble and brushing of grass blades, close-miked outdoors.
sounds.notes: Gain from the ball's speed while it is on the ground.

sounds.prompt: High-quality, professionally recorded foley one-shot: a soccer ball dropped onto short grass from waist height, a single soft thump, close-miked outdoors.
Ambience: the leaves of small trees rustling in a steady breeze, a soft continuous rustle, close-miked outdoors.
sounds.notes: A few positional emitters near the player's nearest trees.

sounds.prompt: High-quality recording of a very soft, tiny tick of a small plastic button, short and clean, close-miked in a quiet room.
sounds.notes: Focus moves, the F Drive prompt appearing and touch button presses.
